title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function is a sum of squared differences. Think about how you can minimize this type of function. What role does each parameter play in the equation?

title: Partial Derivative with Respect to $$\Theta_0$$
text: To find the optimal value of $$\theta_0$$, consider taking the partial derivative of the objective function with respect to $$\theta_0$$. What happens to the function when you set this derivative to zero?

title: Simplifying the Derivative
text: After taking the derivative, you should have an expression involving $$\theta_0$$, $$\theta_1$$, $$y_i$$, and $$x_i$$. Which of the following represents the simplified form of this expression?
